title: Quick bench digest — inference runs
body:
Mini bench sheet — focus: quick knobs to reduce p95 while keeping cost in check

Columns: run_id | model | quant | seq_len | batch_size | hw | throughput_tok_s | avg_latency_ms | p95_ms | est_cost_$per_1M_tokens | notes

R001 | llama-3b | int8 | 128 | 8 | A10G | 15,200 | 22.4 | 58 | 4.2 | baseline with continuous batching on, no KV cache
R002 | llama-3b | int8 | 128 | 8 | A10G | 18,400 | 18.6 | 42 | 3.5 | enabled prefix KV-cache for 20% traffic — big p95 drop
R003 | llama-3b | int4 | 128 | 8 | A10G | 17,600 | 20.1 | 48 | 2.9 | int4 micro-regression on avg latency but cost lower
R004 | llama-3b | int8 | 512 | 4 | A10G | 6,100 | 44.2 | 110 | 5.0 | long sequence, batching smaller to avoid OOM, p95 spikes
R005 | mpt-7b | fp16 | 128 | 12 | A10G | 21,900 | 16.2 | 36 | 6.1 | higher throughput but cost per token higher (model size)
R006 | gptj-6b | int8 | 64 | 16 | T4 | 9,800 | 12.8 | 30 | 3.2 | short seq, cheap hw, decent p95
R007 | llama-3b | int8 | 128 | 8 | A10G | 19,000 | 17.8 | 40 | 3.6 | rerun of R002 with small scheduler tweak
R008 | llama-3b | int8 | 128 | 8 | a10g-cluster | 20,500 | 16.9 | 35 | 3.4 | cluster pooling + fast routing, improved throughput

Quick observations / hypotheses:
- KV caching reduces p95 significantly when prefix reuse > ~15%%. Need to quantify cache hit distribution across request types.
- int4 gives lower cost but subtle latency regressions; verify kernel selection for int4 path (falling back to slower matmul?).
- For long seq (>=512) we should force smaller batch sizes and prefer A100 when available; investigate dynamic kernel swapping.
- Small scheduler tweak (R002->R007) suggests tail latency sensitive to scheduling bursts; look at token-level scheduling traces.

Open TODOs (personal):
- Add per-run CPU steal / host metrics next iteration to rule out OS noise.
- Attach raw perf logs (perf events, nvprof) to LINEAR-2035.
- Compute 95/99 cost impact for typical prod mix (mix: 70%% short-chat, 20%% medium, 10%% long).
- Try model shard + quantize pipeline on a10g-cluster next week.

Notes to self (messy):
- Slack thread: #perf-runs -> see messages around Feb 26 for batch config rationale.
- PR 482 contains the scheduler tweak; may need to roll back if p99 worsens.
- Sample calculation for est cost: cost($/1M tokens) = (instance_hour_cost / (throughput_tok_s * 3600)) * 1e6 ; ok for back-of-envelope

Scratch checks:
- R002 vs R001: p95 down 16ms, throughput +21%%. Try isolating whether cache hit alone or combined with small placement change.
- R008 may be slightly optimistic — cluster test had <10 clients; simulate 100 concurrent clients next to verify.

Next immediate steps (3 items):
1) Re-run R003 with explicit kernel log enabled (set ENV KERNEL_TRACE=1) and attach to PR.
2) Add a quick column for cache_hit_rate in next sheet iteration.
3) Draft short note for eng-applied-ml sync: prioritize KV-cache telemetry and int4 kernel stability.

End of sheet — quick, messy, useful.
